text_block_list.text:
With the Japan Dirt Derby drawing near,
Smart
Falcon begins her summer camp
training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон took on the Satsuki Sho to
please
her fans, despite her weakness on
turf. Next, it's
time to show them her
true strength on the dirt.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Everything Смарт Фалкон does is for the
fans who
support her. As always, she
prepares to give it her
all.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
